text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *yaaaawn*~aaaaah... Mornin'~...

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, hey, hey! Did you see it?! 
Yesterday's issue of "Monthly Twinkle"!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy early in the morning, 
aren't ya... What's up, did you read 
something interesting?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, snap out of it! This is 
seriously bad! Look at the pre-race 
popularity poll for the Nippon Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You know, that Ayabe-san, for the first 
time—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (2nd place...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: In 1st place is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Narita Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Kh, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —All right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to it... I really do!! I 
want to show them the dream... At the 
Japanese Derby, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Taaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan's ahead, and Ayabe-san's 
behind... Keep calm, don't rush too far 
forward in the early stages...! Settle in 
just behind midfield—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The middle leg... slowly improve 
position... But hold back, hold back, hold 
back—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fourth corner!! Making the move first!! 
Passing Opera O!! Shaking off Ayabe-san—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's mine for the taking!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...It's so hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Because of the light she emits—it's so 
hot.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm~... Ah!! Um, excuse me, Ayabe-san!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ? ...Special Week-san. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... Here! Please take this, if 
you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......A rice ball?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! These are giant rice balls, made just 
the way Mama taught me!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, the fillings actually change 
depending on the spot! What I put in this 
time was salmon, bonito flakes, and 
mountain wasabi—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait. ...Why me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... hehe, I wondered if I might be 
meddling too much, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"We talked here right before the Satsuki 
Sho too, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Ayabe-san barely ate anything, 
and she seemed so down...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Ayabe-san looked so vibrant and 
full of life when I watched the Satsuki 
Sho on the dorm TV!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, um... since we're here anyway, I 
thought we might as well!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Since we're here...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to compete against 
Grass-chan, El-chan, Sei-chan, and 
King-chan, I want to go into it on a 
completely full stomach and at my very 
best, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why I want to give it my all 
and compete against everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I want to compete... with everything I 
have...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Derby just around the 
corner— Admire Vega appeared to be in peak 
condition!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although, Narita Top Road, who ceded the 
number one spot in the preliminary 
popularity polls for the first time, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"TM Opera O showed unstoppable momentum in 
the Satsuki Sho, and she seems to be in 
peak condition, but..."
choice_data_list: Ayabe, you think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I will win... I swear it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...I look forward to working with you 
today! It's a showdown!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ………………I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's have a match.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh—the look in your eyes has changed, 
Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Spandendo, Spandendo!! More richly!! More 
powerfully!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Shall we play our music—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime grand stage. The 
Japanese Derby raises its curtain.
